title: Targeted causal and divine-action source audit

loci.reason: Makes sole total production,differentiated contributions and mixed joint production explicit;unchanged cooperator cannot have the same complete power/output alone.
Adds coalescence and perfection/independence bridges to move from cooperation to denial of intrinsic necessity.
Continuous context distinguishes actual diverse contributions,necessary agreement,prior causal receipt,lawful concomitance,actual world-interconnection,and choice versus external prevention.
Perfection argument links intrinsic power to creator independence and rejects circular completion of efficient capacity;Salim1:92–93 directly electronically page-bound,with1:94–95 continuation.
Particular acts/effects can emerge without renewal of essential perfection or power received from another.
Adds acts subsisting in the agent through power/will to expose the false eternal-particular/separated-creature binary.
Supplies a causal no-total-stripping argument at any time,distinct from mere availability;does not establish every kind at every time.
Intrinsic recurring genus and successive acts differ from a fixed eternal particular;effect differs from act;mere concurrence differs from efficient production.
Reiterates power/possibility,explicitly handles third-cause concomitance and common-world interaction;possibility argument alone remains modal.

main_result: A plural-cooperation model that drops unlimited independent agency,coalescence,or the causal/perfection bridges does not preserve the full source-premise set. Temporal emergence of divine action must not be relabelled Created or externally received perfection. A stronger independent causal argument bears against complete global inactivity;it is not an inference from possibility alone.
stopping_condition: Requested Arabic contextual reading,analysis,and exact Salim electronic page binding complete. No scan/manuscript certification beyond listed Adwa controls. Larger project closure remains a separate receiving-integration decision.
quantifier_limits: No actual perpetual tokens from persistent possibility alone
No identification of particular-token cessation with loss of a power or genus
No source ontology reduced to the G-empty/all-emergent-empty formal control
No source-independent contradiction alleged merely because a candidate rejects metaphysical coalescence
witness_limits: Salim pagination verified electronically,not by Salim scan
Dar9 full continuous Arabic source read with bounded page anchors,not full print/apparatus collation
